name: Python Static Compilation CI
# Runs the Python test corpus of inject-python-test with every eligible function body compiled to Java
# (static compilation mode `all`), so whatever the compiler compiles there is checked against tests written
# for the interpreted bodies; plus the corpus of test-suite-python-corpus. The regular Python CI runs them
# in the default mode only. Runs when the static compiler or the runtime it calls changes, and on demand.
# Unlike python.yml, this file is not synced from micronaut-project-template.
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - main
      - '[0-9]+.[0-9]+.x'
      - 'python/**'
      - 'python-*'
      - 'stack/**'
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - 'inject-python/src/main/java/io/micronaut/python/processing/staticcompile/**'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/java/io/micronaut/python/processing/PythonStubGenerator.java'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/java/io/micronaut/python/processing/PythonAstParser.java'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/resources/GRAALPY-VFS/io.micronaut/micronaut-inject-python/src/micronaut_processor.py'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/resources/GRAALPY-VFS/io.micronaut/micronaut-inject-python/src/micronaut_transformer.py'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/resources/GRAALPY-VFS/io.micronaut/micronaut-inject-python/src/micronaut_static.py'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/resources/GRAALPY-VFS/io.micronaut/micronaut-inject-python/src/micronaut_lowering.py'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/resources/GRAALPY-VFS/io.micronaut/micronaut-inject-python/src/micronaut_typecheck.py'
      - 'context-python/src/main/java/io/micronaut/context/python/PythonStatic.java'
      - 'context-python/src/main/java/io/micronaut/context/python/aop/StaticAdvice*.java'
      - 'test-suite-python-corpus/**'
      - '.github/workflows/python-static-compilation.yml'
  push:
    branches:
      - '[0-9]+.[0-9]+.x'
    paths:
      - 'inject-python/src/main/java/io/micronaut/python/processing/staticcompile/**'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/java/io/micronaut/python/processing/PythonStubGenerator.java'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/java/io/micronaut/python/processing/PythonAstParser.java'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/resources/GRAALPY-VFS/io.micronaut/micronaut-inject-python/src/micronaut_processor.py'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/resources/GRAALPY-VFS/io.micronaut/micronaut-inject-python/src/micronaut_transformer.py'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/resources/GRAALPY-VFS/io.micronaut/micronaut-inject-python/src/micronaut_static.py'
      - 'inject-python/src/main/resources/GRAALPY-VFS/io.micronaut/micronaut-inject-python/src/micronaut_lowering.py'
      - 'context-python/src/main/java/io/micronaut/context/python/PythonStatic.java'
      - '.github/workflows/python-static-compilation.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      budget:
        description: "Also assert the compile-time budget of mode all (StaticCompilationBudgetTest)"
        type: boolean
        default: false
